[SWS_SwCluC_02284]
SwCluCBManifProvideResourceEntryGroup
for
SwCluCOsProxyOsTask ⌈For the Os Low Proxy, there shall be a SwCluCBManif-
ProvideResourceEntryGroup, whose SwCluCBManifResourceTypeRef shall
refer to a SwCluCBManifResourceType that contains one SwCluCBManifNoti-
fierHandle, with SwCluCBManifNativeHandleType set to FUNCTION_REFER-
ENCE.
The SwCluCBManifMultipleNotifierSupport shall be set to MULTIPLE_-
NOTIFIER_SETS.⌋
